latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of echoflow-image-gen skill using the EchoFlow API and Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image)
- Supports image generation, single-image editing, and multi-image composition (up to 14 images)
- Includes options for resolution (1K, 2K, 4K) and model selection
- Outputs saved image paths and MEDIA tokens for easy integration with chat platforms
- Provides detailed CLI usage examples and setup instructions
- Requires ECHOFLOW_API_KEY environment variable for authentication
